subject: art-design
title: Colour Wheel & Mixing
welcome_lead: Build the colour wheel from scratch.
meta_desc: KS3 colour theory: primaries, secondaries, tertiaries on the wheel.
final_note: Once you can build the wheel, you can mix anything.

concepts.def: Red, yellow, blue — cannot be mixed.
Orange, green, purple — mix of two primaries.
Combining colours to make new ones.

walkthroughs.body_html: Draw a circle. Put red at 12, yellow at 4 o'clock, blue at 8. These three are evenly spaced.
Mix each pair: orange between red and yellow, green between yellow and blue, purple between blue and red. Now you have six colours.
Between each primary and secondary mix a tertiary: red-orange, yellow-orange, yellow-green, blue-green, blue-purple, red-purple. Now twelve colours sit on the wheel.
